changelog:
Initial release of the Customer Advisory Board skill:

- Provides a comprehensive CAB program plan, including charter, member selection, agenda, discussion guides, roles, logistics, and follow-up.
- Focuses on gathering honest strategic input and creating value for members, not just the company.
- Defines clear required inputs and a structured process for building and running a CAB.
- Includes quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure best practices.
- Output is a ready-to-use CAB program template covering all essentials.
summary: Plan and run a customer advisory board (CAB). Use when asked to design a customer advisory board, plan a CAB meeting agenda, choose CAB members, or write CAB...
